Shirolos is a distilled preparation combining Sweet Galenas and white wine. The adaptation associates it with temperate heaths and scrublands, although its rarity also reflects the specialized knowledge needed to produce the finished substance.

This respiratory poison chiefly affects consciousness. The victim may fall into extreme drowsiness, or enter a trance in which they become unusually suggestible. Such effects may last many tens of hours. The corpus also records addiction risk after repeated use. Their severity depends on the level 10 Resistance Roll.
